questions.q: In 'The Lion and the Mouse', what woke the Lion from his nap?
choices: The Mouse ran across his nose

questions.q: In 'The Lion and the Mouse', how did the Mouse help the Lion?
choices: She gnawed the rope of the net until it broke
She called other lions to help
questions.evidence: she gnawed it until it parted

questions.q: What is the lesson of 'The Lion and the Mouse'?
In 'The Shepherd Boy and the Wolf', why did the Boy first shout "Wolf! Wolf!"?
choices: He was bored and wanted to play a trick
He wanted to go home early
questions.evidence: he thought of a plan to amuse himself

questions.q: In 'The Shepherd Boy and the Wolf', why didn't the Villagers come when the Wolf really came?
choices: They thought the Boy was tricking them again
They were afraid of the Wolf

questions.q: In 'The Gnat and the Bull', what did the Bull say when the Gnat was leaving?
choices: He did not even know the Gnat was there
He was glad the Gnat was going
He wanted the Gnat to stay
The Gnat had hurt his horn
questions.evidence: I did not even know you were there.

questions.q: In 'The Plane Tree', why did the Tree call the Travellers ungrateful?
choices: They rested in its shade but called it useless
questions.evidence: You lie here in my cooling shade, and yet you say I am useless!

questions.q: In 'The Farmer and the Stork', why was the Stork punished even though he did not steal?
choices: He was caught with the thieving Cranes
questions.evidence: You are judged by the company you keep.
